paper.title: Forward Laplacian: A New Computational Framework for Neural Network-based Variational Monte Carlo
paper.authors: Ruichen Li, Haotian Ye, Du Jiang, Xuelan Wen, Chuwei Wang, Zhe Li, Xiang Li, Di He, Ji Chen, Weiluo Ren, Liwei Wang

results.system_description: N2 at bond length 2.068 bohr, all electrons, singlet (7 up, 7 down), clamped nuclei
results.eligibility_evidence: VMC energy of the trained LapNet from MCMC sampling without parameter updates; total energy and standard error from a reblocking analysis (Sec. 4).
results.notes: Geometry: the configurations of Pfau et al. and von Glehn et al. ('[1,2]'); the Psiformer and FermiNet columns of the same table are quoted from von Glehn et al. and are not recorded here.
